answer.reason: Acts gives events that happened at Cyprus: Barnabas and Saul preached there, and Barnabas sailed there with Mark.

clauses.english: was where Barnabas and Saul landed and preached in the synagogues, sent out by the Holy Ghost
clauses.quote: from thence they sailed to Cyprus

clauses.english: was where Barnabas sailed with Mark after parting from Paul
clauses.quote: Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus

doubts: ISA 23:1, ISA 23:12, JER 2:10 and EZK 27:6 name Chittim, which the verses do not identify as Cyprus, so they were left out.
ACT 4:36, ACT 11:19-20, ACT 21:16 only say people came from Cyprus, so they were not used.
ACT 21:3 and ACT 27:4 only mark a stage of a voyage.
